about: Hand-written expected lab directions for high-yield condition and test pairs, used by the profile rule checks (tools/kb-generate/checks.py, supabase/functions/_shared/profilegen.ts) to catch severity ranges that move the wrong way. up / down: the value moves away from normal as severity rises and the most severe listed range sits outside normal. normal_or_up / normal_or_down: no severity may fall on the other side of normal. Test ids are from reference_ranges.json; derived tests (anion gap) are computed by code, so they never appear here. Teaching values, not clinical guidance.
